disclaimer: This summary is for convenience. The issuer MITC prevails. Charges in the MITC are exclusive of GST. The network is not stated in the MITC heading.

annual_waiver.summary: The annual fee is waived on ₹1.2 lakh of eligible spends in the preceding year.

fuel_surcharge.summary: Fuel surcharge is 1 percent of the transaction or ₹10, whichever is higher. A waiver applies on fuel spends up to ₹4,000 per billing cycle.

conditions.summary: The fuel waiver applies up to ₹4,000 per billing cycle.

base_earn.summary: Qualified spends earn 2 Jewels per ₹100 on the Jupiter app, with a minimum transaction of ₹100. The billing-cycle cap is 15,000 Jewels. Five Jewels equal ₹1.

conditions.summary: The minimum transaction to earn Jewels is ₹100.
Jewels are capped at 15,000 per billing cycle.

accelerated.summary: An optional booster pack earns 10 Jewels per ₹100 on a chosen MCC category and still sits inside the 15,000 cycle cap.

upi.notes: Edge-Federal MITC does not describe a separate UPI earn rate.

redemption.summary: Redeem as digital gold on Jupiter or as cash to a Federal Bank account at 5 Jewels equals ₹1. Unpaid minimum amount due locks Jewels and pauses earning.

expiry.summary: Jewels do not expire except when unused for more than 365 days, plus clawback cases in the MITC.
